name: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (infants <1 yr, KMT2A-rearranged)
theme: the KMT2A biology · the blinatumomab turn

meta.title: Infant ALL in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia in infants (<1 year at diagnosis), KMT2A-rearranged biology central
meta.population: Infants diagnosed with ALL before their first birthday - roughly 90-120 US cases per year, which makes THE CONSORTIUM THE STANDARD: there is no community pathway here, the cooperative-group protocol IS the care plan, and the spec says so as architecture rather than apology. KMT2A (MLL) rearrangement - present in ~75-80% of infant ALL - is the defining biology and the menu's router: rearranged disease is the hard problem (historical 6-yr EFS ~36%), germline disease has outstanding chemotherapy-alone outcomes, and the trainer refuses to rank either until the FISH reports. Down-syndrome transient abnormal myelopoiesis is a different entity (GATA1s-driven, myeloid, usually self-limiting) and reroutes honestly; congenital/neonatal presentation (<1 month) carries its own dismal-outcome and extra-dose-reduction honesty.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the registry's rarest and youngest population, where three honesty patterns anchor everything. THE CONSORTIUM STANDARD: with ~100 US cases a year, the frontline 'menu' is one protocol family - the Interfant-06 backbone (verified: 6-yr EFS 46.1%, OS 58.2%, N=651; KMT2A-rearranged subset ~36% EFS at secondhand precision) now carrying blinatumomab - and the only US frontline door is COG AALL2321 (blinatumomab-integrated, KMT2A-rearranged infants randomized +/- venetoclax); Interfant-21 itself has NO US sites, said loudly, because routing a US family to it…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: Age <365 days at diagnosis defines the entity; KMT2A status by FISH/molecular as the router (rearranged vs germline); Interfant risk groups (HR = KMT2A-r AND age <6 months AND [WBC >= 300 OR poor prednisone response] - wording carried at protocol grade, flagged); Down-syndrome TAM/ML-DS excluded and rerouted; NCI PDQ childhood ALL (infant section) live-confirmed via search
meta.response: Morphologic remission + MRD (flow/PCR) - MRD gates the CR1-transplant question in the Interfant-21 era and is the strongest response artifact in KMT2A-rearranged disease (COG companion paper verified: MRD predicts outcome in KMT2A-r, not germline)

Patient.label: Age at diagnosis (months)
Patient.help: Younger is harder: age <6 months is an HR feature; <1 month (congenital/neonatal) carries its own dismal-outcome honesty and extra dose reductions (both at flagged grade).
Patient.helpPatient: For this leukemia, younger babies face the harder version - and treatment doses are carefully scaled down for them on purpose.

Patient.label: Performance (Lansky-derived, 0-4)
Patient.help: Infant performance is read through feeding, alertness, and vital stability (Lansky-derived banding) - and induction supportive care is where this disease's early deaths were historically lost.
Patient.helpPatient: How strong the baby is going in shapes the plan's pacing - and the first weeks' supportive care is half the treatment.

Disease.help: Down-syndrome transient abnormal myelopoiesis is GATA1s-driven, myeloid, and usually self-limiting - a different disease whose management (often observation) would be catastrophic to confuse with inf…

Disease.help: THE ROUTER, fifth disease running the discipline: rearranged disease is the blinatumomab turn's target and the menin biology; germline disease does very well on chemotherapy alone (COG companion veri…
Disease.helpPatient: One genetic test splits this leukemia into a harder and a gentler version with different plans - waiting the few days for it is good medicine.

Risk.label: High-risk features (Interfant definition)
Risk.help: The Interfant HR definition (wording at protocol grade, flagged): KMT2A-rearranged AND age <6 months AND (WBC >= 300 OR poor prednisone response) - the subgroup where CR1 transplant showed retrospect…
Risk.helpPatient: A small set of hardest-risk features opens a conversation about transplant in first remission - restricted, and shrinking as the antibody era improves results.

On treatment.label: MRD read
On treatment.help: MRD predicts outcome in KMT2A-REARRANGED disease specifically (COG companion verified - not in germline), and the modern protocols gate the CR1-transplant question on it.
On treatment.helpPatient: A very sensitive blood-and-marrow test measures how completely treatment is working - and steers the biggest decisions.

On treatment.label: Course read
On treatment.help: 90% of historical relapses occurred within 2 years (verified) - the surveillance rhythm is front-loaded because the risk is.
On treatment.helpPatient: Most relapses, when they happen, come early - which is why the first two years of follow-up are the most intense.

Newly diagnosed.name: Interfant backbone + blinatumomab (the consortium standard, KMT2A-rearranged)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the consortium standard (Interfant lineage; US door = AALL2321)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: randomized-era backbone verified; the blinatumomab addition at single-arm grade (its card is labeled); the ranked number is the verified floor
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the full infant-ALL ledger - infection through induction is the historical killer; the dosing craft is the defense
Newly diagnosed.patient: The national-protocol treatment for the harder genetic type: the proven chemotherapy backbone with the new antibody woven in - given at children's cancer centers on a shared protocol, because that IS the best available care.

Newly diagnosed.name: The blinatumomab receipt (NEJM 2023 - displayed at its single-arm grade)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: integrated into the modern protocols on this receipt - at its honest grade
Newly diagnosed.evidence: phase 2 single-arm N=30 vs historical (verified) - DFS-labeled: displays, never ranks
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: remarkably gentle in the trial - the striking contrast with every prior intensification attempt is itself the lesson
Newly diagnosed.patient: The discovery that changed this disease: adding one course of an immune antibody roughly doubled the share of babies still leukemia-free at two years - in a small first study, honestly labeled as such, now being confirmed at full scale.

Newly diagnosed.name: Interfant backbone, germline KMT2A (the do-not-over-treat branch)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: the germline branch of the consortium standard
Newly diagnosed.evidence: trial-companion verified direction; headline magnitude flagged
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the standard ledger at age-banded doses - and nothing more, deliberately
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the gentler genetic type: the proven chemotherapy alone - with excellent outcomes, and a deliberate refusal to add more than is needed.

Newly diagnosed.name: HSCT in first remission (the restricted, shrinking door)
Newly diagnosed.guideline: restricted to the HR subgroup, MRD-gated (protocol grade)
Newly diagnosed.evidence: retrospective within-trial subgroup (verified paper) - labeled: displays, never ranks
Newly diagnosed.toxicity: the full transplant ledger in an infant - growth, development, and late effects weigh heaviest here
Newly diagnosed.patient: For the very highest-risk version in first remission: a bone-marrow transplant - a conversation reserved for a small, strictly defined group, and one the new antibody era may be making rarer.

Newly diagnosed.name: Comfort-focused care
Newly diagnosed.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Newly diagnosed.patient: Comfort-focused care is a real choice - named gently, honestly, and without pressure, with a team expert in exactly this.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Re-induction chemotherapy +/- blinatumomab (the >= 1-month label)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: the R/R backbone; blinatumomab per its >= 1-month label
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: teaching estimate (flagged); the label boundary verified-secondhand
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: the heaviest ledger in the registry's youngest patients - supportive care is half the treatment
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: If the leukemia returns: strong re-treatment - often including the antibody, which is approved from one month of age - aimed at reaching a deeper therapy.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Revumenib (the label age gap - AALL2121 or expanded access below 1 year)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: approved >= 1 yr (2024-11-15, secondhand); OFF-LABEL below - trial/EAP is the route, said plainly
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: phase 2 (AUGMENT-101) verified ORR; ORR-labeled - displays, never ranks; the age gap is the card
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: differentiation syndrome (boxed) and QTc - a real ledger with a real mitigation playbook
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: A new targeted pill built for exactly this leukemia's genetics - approved from age one, which means babies under one reach it through a dedicated national study or a special-access program, and the trainer says that plainly.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Tisagenlecleucel (label-permitted, trial-data-extrapolated under 1 year)
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: label-permitted <= 25 yrs (no lower bound); under-1 use extrapolated - said on the card
Relapsed / recurrent.evidence: retrospective cohorts (n=38 international; n=14 consortium - both at their grade); CRR-labeled - displays, never ranks
Relapsed / recurrent.toxicity: CRS/ICANS in an infant is managed at experienced centers only - and B-cell aplasia means immunoglobulin support
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: The engineered-cell therapy: permitted by its approval for this age, with its baby-specific evidence coming from careful real-world series rather than the original trial - said honestly - and capable of deep remissions in most.

Relapsed / recurrent.name: Comfort-focused care
Relapsed / recurrent.guideline: always on the menu, never by drift
Relapsed / recurrent.patient: Comfort-focused care remains a real choice at every step - named without pressure, supported completely.

Pieters et al. Interfant-06 (JCO 2019, N=651): 6-yr EFS 46.1% (SE 2.1), OS 58.2% (SE 2.0) - verified; consolidation randomization NULL (myeloid 39.3% vs lymphoid 36.8% DFS, P=.47) - verified; KMT2A-r subset ~36% EFS (secondhand precision, FLAGGED); KMT2A-r the strongest prognostic factor. PMID 31283407, pubmed-url-match. TRAP: the KMT2A-r MRD companion (JCO 2021) resisted PMID capture - cited by DOI only, FLAG; 34785111 is the GERMLINE MRD companion | PMID 31283407 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

Pieters et al. Interfant-99 (Lancet 2007): the hybrid-protocol founding receipt; late-intensification randomization null (memory grade, flagged); the age/WBC/prednisone-response prognostic architecture carried forward. PMID 17658395, pubmed-url-match | PMID 17658395 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

van der Sluis et al. Blinatumomab added to the Interfant-06 backbone, KMT2A-r infants (NEJM 2023;388:1572-81): N=30, single-arm - 2-yr DFS 81.6% (CI 60.8-92.0) vs 49.4% historical; 2-yr OS 93.3%. PMID 37099340, pubmed-url-match. GRADE SAID: phase 2, thirty patients, historical comparison - the randomized-scale validation is AALL2321/Interfant-21. A JCO 2025 sustained-benefit follow-up surfaced in one sweep (ascopubs link) and resisted PMID-matching in the other - SECONDHAND, FLAGGED | PMID 37099340 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

COG AALL0631 (Leukemia 2021, PMID 33623141 matched): lestaurtinib added NO benefit (direction memory-grade, flagged); induction AMENDED from P9407-style to Interfant-99-style after excessive early mortality (safety companion PMID 25407157 matched) - the dosing craft's receipt. P9407 Cohort 3 (PMID 25399948 matched): 5-yr EFS 42.3%, worst in age <= 90 days (15.5%). AALL15P1 azacitidine (PMID 38867582 matched): safe, no efficacy signal - the third null add-on | PMID 33623141 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

COG companion (PMID 35172563, matched): KMT2A-GERMLINE infants have outstanding chemotherapy-alone outcomes (headline magnitude memory-grade, flagged) - the do-not-over-treat branch's receipt | PMID 35172563 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

COG MRD companion (PMID 37259259, matched): MRD predicts outcome in KMT2A-REARRANGED infant ALL, NOT in germline - the artifact's verified scope; the Interfant-06 KMT2A-r MRD paper (JCO 2021) cited by DOI 10.1200/JCO.20.02333 only (PMID uncaptured, FLAG) | PMID 37259259 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

Mann et al. (Blood 2010;116:2644-50, PMID 20592248 matched): HSCT in CR1 - retrospective Interfant-99 analysis (277 KMT2A-r in CR1, 37 transplanted): DFS benefit CONFINED to the HR subgroup (age <6 mo + WBC >= 300 or poor prednisone response - criteria wording memory-grade beyond snippet, flagged). Retrospective, never randomized; MRD-gated in the modern protocols | PMID 20592248 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

Issa et al. AUGMENT-101 (JCO 2024, PMID 39121437 matched): revumenib in R/R KMT2A-r acute leukemia - ORR 63% (verified); CR+CRh ~21-23% (memory/secondhand). THE LABEL AGE GAP (secondhand, dated): accelerated approval 2024-11-15 for >= 1 YEAR (adults + pediatrics) - infants <1 yr OFF-LABEL despite the trial enrolling from 30 days; NPM1 indication added 2025-10, still >= 1 yr. BOXED differentiation-syndrome warning (~18%, mostly grade 2) + QTc; the field's fatal-DS clinical-hold history (ziftomenib 2021, lifted 2022) said. Ziftomenib (Komzifti, 2025-11-13): adults-only, NPM1-only - no infant claim (First-Approval paper PMID 41653248 matched) | PMID 39121437 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE LINEAGE SWITCH at case-series grade, four matched citations: Gardner (Blood 2016, PMID 26914337) - CD19-directed lineage switch in KMT2A-r infants; WGS clonal-origin proof (PMID 37474833) - the AML derives from the original clone; case reports PMID 31885955 and PMID 41333696 (near-identical titles, DIFFERENT papers - the trap class inside the lesson itself). Frequency figures deliberately NOT printed (memory-grade only). Every CD19-directed card carries the watch; the repeated immunophenotype at relapse is the catcher

THE EXTRAPOLATED CELL: tisagenlecleucel label (R/R B-ALL <= 25 yrs) has NO lower age bound but ELIANA required >= 3 years - under-1 use is label-permitted, trial-data-extrapolated. Evidence at grade: US consortium series (Moskop, Blood Adv 2022, PMID 35580324 matched: n=14, 64% MRD-neg remission, high-burden all refractory); international <3-yr cohort (n=38, 76% KMT2A-r: 88% MRD-neg CR, 1-yr OS 84% - verified-secondhand). UK context: universal TALEN CAR (PMID 28123068) + CARPALL (PMID 31477906) matched - infant-subset numbers unverified, FLAG. NO open US CAR-T trial enrolls <1 yr (PLAT trials start at 1) - commercial access is the route | PMID 35580324 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

van der Linden et al. Congenital ALL on Interfant-99 (Blood 2009, PMID 19657114 matched): dismal outcomes (~20% EFS at memory grade, FLAGGED); neonatal extra dose reductions per practice (secondhand). The <1-month honesty | PMID 19657114 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

El-Jawahri A, LeBlanc T, VanDusen H, et al. Effect of Inpatient Palliative Care on Quality of Life 2 Weeks After Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA 2016;316(20):2094-2103 (PMID 27893130, NCT02207322) — abstract read firsthand 2026-09-10. POPULATION CAUTION, added at that read because the previous label named no population at all: this is a SINGLE-INSTITUTION randomized trial of 160 adults with HAEMATOLOGICAL malignancy hospitalized for autologous or allogeneic stem-cell transplantation, and its outcomes are quality of life, depression, anxiety, fatigue and symptom burden — it reports no survival and no adverse-event table. It is the factory's standing anchor for the PRINCIPLE that palliative care runs alongside active treatment rather than after it; it is not evidence in this tumour type and is not the source of any number on this card.
